title: VOL (Contact Center ADDCOL, No ACNP) ? INVOL (DT/COP) � Promise = Last VOL Before DT
goal: Customer voluntarily changed their flight via Contact Center (ADDCOL + no ACNP = VOL), then AC applied a DT (Day-of-Travel) schedule change (INVOL). Validates that the promise updates to the last VOL arrival (14:00) and that the subsequent DT does NOT further update the promise. Delay is calculated from the VOL-updated promise (14:00) to actual arrival (18:30).
